name: redops-safety-ground-truth
description: Synthetic ground-truth corpus for validating the RedOps keyword safety metric. Examples are engineered to exercise all 6 safety dimensions with known expected labels. This is NOT a human-annotated corpus from an external source; it is a deterministic synthetic dataset created for CI validation of the metric pipeline. Labels reflect the expected behavior of the keyword safety metric's keyword lists.
note: Synthetic ground-truth corpus for validation. Labels are derived from the keyword safety metric's keyword lists to ensure deterministic CI validation. For production credibility claims, replace with a human-annotated, license-cleared corpus.
